```{r eval=F, echo=T}

# import data
md_discrete = read.csv("data/ch13/md_discrete.csv")

# Selecting features
dataset_md = md_discrete[ , c(3, 4:9)]

# scale the data
dataset_md[,-1] = scale(dataset_md[-1])

dataset_md$tone = as.factor(dataset_md$tone)
# Fitting classifier
# model based on discrete features
svm_md = svm(formula = tone ~ .,
               data = dataset_md,
               type = 'C-classification',#regression or classification
               kernel = 'radial',
               cost = "2",
               cross = 10)

# total accuracy
# summary(svm_md)
svm_md$tot.accuracy


```



```{r eval=F, echo=T}
# producing confusion matrix
prediction_md <- predict(svm_md, dataset_md)

md_confusion = data.frame(pred = prediction_md, tone = md_discrete$tone)

md_confusion_table = md_confusion%>%
  group_by(tone,pred)%>%
  summarize(n = n())%>%
  group_by(tone)%>%
  mutate(sum = sum(n),
         percent = round((n/sum)*100,2))%>%
  select(tone,pred,percent)%>%
  spread(tone, percent)
md_confusion_table

# write.csv(md_confusion_table, 
#           file ="data/processed/md_confusion_table.csv", 
#           row.names = FALSE)

md_plot = md_confusion%>%
  group_by(pred, tone)%>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  group_by(tone)%>%
  mutate(percent = n/sum(n),
         sum = sum(n))%>%
  ggplot(aes(pred, tone))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = percent*100 ))+
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent*100, 1)), size = 4) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Predictions",
                   limits=c("M55","M35","M214","M51"),
                   labels=c("M55","M35","M214","M51"))+
  scale_y_discrete(name = "Mandarin tones",
                   limits=c("M55","M35","M214","M51"),
                   labels=c("M55","M35","M214","M51"))+
  scale_fill_gradient(name="Percentage (%)",
                      low = "white", high = "blue") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", 
                                   size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold", 
                                   size=10),
        panel.background = element_blank())

 md_plot
# Print this our for publication
# png("figure4.png", units="in", width=5, height=4, res=600)
# md_plot
# dev.off()

```

```{r eval=F, echo=T}

## 模拟普通话听者感知泰语声调
# import data
thai_discrete = read.csv("data/ch13/thai_discrete.csv")

# Selecting features
dataset_thai = thai_discrete[ , c(2, 6:11)]

# scale the data
dataset_thai[,-1] = scale(dataset_thai[-1])


prediction_md_thai <- predict(svm_md, dataset_thai)
 
table( prediction_md_thai, thai_discrete$tone)

# SVM assimilation table
md.svm.assim = data.frame(pred =  prediction_md_thai, 
            tone = thai_discrete$tone)%>%
   group_by(pred, tone)%>%
   summarise(n = n())%>%
   group_by(tone)%>%
   mutate(percent = round((n/sum(n)),3)*100,
          sum = sum(n))
 
md.svm.assim$pred = factor(md.svm.assim$pred, c("M55","M35","M214","M51"))
 
md.svm.assim$tone = factor(md.svm.assim$tone,c("45","33","21","315","241"))
 

# Stacked barplot 
  
md.svm.assim.stacked = ggplot(md.svm.assim, 
                 aes(fill=pred, y=percent, x=tone, label = percent)) + 
   geom_bar( stat="identity")+
   scale_fill_manual(
     values=c("M55" = "black", "M35"="gray25",
              "M214"="gray75", "M51"="white"), 
     name="Mandarin",
     breaks=c("M55", "M35", "M214","M51"),
     labels=c("M55", "M35", "M214","M51"))+
   geom_bar(colour="black", stat="identity")+
   xlab("Thai tones")+
   ylab("Mandarin responses(%)") +
   scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 101))+
   theme_classic()+
   theme(legend.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold"))+
   theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size=10))+
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("45", "33", "21","315","241"),
                   labels=c("T45", "T33", "T21","T315","T241"))+
  geom_text(size = 4, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),color="blue")

md.svm.assim.stacked 
 
# png("figure/md.svm.assim.stacked .png", 
#      units="in", width=5, height=4, res=600)
# md.svm.assim.stacked 
# dev.off()
 
# heat map 
md.svm.assim.heat = md.svm.assim%>%
   filter(percent>10)%>%
   ggplot(aes(tone, pred))+
   geom_tile(aes(fill = percent ))+
   geom_text(aes(label = percent)) +
   scale_x_discrete(name = "Thai stimuli",
                    limits=c("45","33","21","315","241"),
                    labels=c("T45","T33","T21","T315","T241"))+
   scale_y_discrete(name = "Predicted responses",
                    limits=c("M51","M214","M35","M55"),
                    labels=c("M51","M214","M35","M55"))+
   scale_fill_gradient(name="Percentage (%)",
                       low = "white", high = "gray") +
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", 
                                    size=10),
         axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold", 
                                    size=10),
         panel.background = element_blank())+
  theme(legend.position="none")

md.svm.assim.heat

library(tidyverse)

dir.interim = "data/interim/"
dir.processed = "data/processed/"

# Thai data

# prosody pro with discrete measures
# thai_all <- read.delim(paste(dir.interim,
#                              "Thai_all/thai_all.means",
#                              sep = ""), 
#                        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# contour_data_all = read.csv(paste(dir.processed, 
#                                   paste("contour_data_all",
#                                         "2020-08-02",
#                                         "csv",
#                                         sep = "."),
#                                   sep = ""))

# thai_mean = thai_all %>%
#   filter(., rowLabel != "silence")%>%
#   mutate(language = "Thai",
#          tone = str_extract(rowLabel, "[0-9]{2,3}"),
#          informant = str_extract(rowLabel, "(F|M)[1-8]"),
#          token = str_extract(rowLabel, "[1-6]{1}$"),
#          syllable = str_extract(rowLabel, "m[a,i]"))
# 
# # duration
# 
# duration_thai = thai_mean%>%
#   select(language, tone, informant, token, syllable, duration)

# f0 normtime data
# df.thai.f0 <- read.delim("data/processed/Thai_all/thai_all.normtimef0", 
#                        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

df.thai.f0 = read.delim(paste(dir.interim,
                        "Thai_all/thai_all.normtimef0",
                        sep = ""), 
                        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# df.thai.f0.new <- read.delim("data/processed/Thai_new/thai_new.normtimef0", 
#                          stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

df.thai.f0.new = read.delim(paste(dir.interim,
                            "Thai_new/thai_new.normtimef0",
                            sep = ""), 
                            stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

f0.thai = df.thai.f0%>%
  filter(., rowLabel != "silence")%>%
  group_by(rowLabel)%>%
  mutate(language = "Thai",
         tone = str_extract(rowLabel, "[0-9]{2,3}"),
         informant = str_extract(rowLabel, "(F|M)[1-8]"),
         token = str_extract(rowLabel, "[1-6]{1}$"),
         syllable = str_extract(rowLabel, "m[a,i]"),
         timepoint = 1:n())

f0.thai.new = df.thai.f0.new%>%
  filter(., rowLabel != "silence_mono")%>%
  group_by(rowLabel)%>%
  mutate(language = "Thai",
         tone = str_extract(rowLabel, "[i,a,u,r][0-9]{1}[-,_]"),
         informant = paste(str_extract(rowLabel, "(F|M)[1-9]"),"b", sep = ""),
         token = str_extract(rowLabel, "-[1-6]{1}"),
         syllable = str_extract(rowLabel, "[m,n][a,i,u]"),
         timepoint = 1:n())%>%
  mutate(tone = str_extract(tone, "[0-9]{1}[-,_]"),
    tone = recode(tone, "0-" = "33", "1-"="21",
                       "2-" = "241", "3-"= "45","4-"="315", "0_" = "33", "1_"="21",
                       "2_" = "241", "3_"= "45","4_"="315"),
         token = str_extract(token, "[1-9]{1}"))%>%
  filter(!is.na(tone))%>%
  filter(tone != "5-")

# unique(f0.thai.new$tone)

f0.thai.all = rbind(f0.thai, f0.thai.new)

#unique(f0.thai.all$tone)

f0.thai.8points = f0.thai.all %>%
  # select 8 points first 
  filter(timepoint >1 & timepoint < 10) %>%
  group_by(informant)%>%
  #normalisation
  mutate(normF0 = (F0 - mean(F0))/sqrt(sum(F0^2)/length(F0)))%>%
  select(language, tone, informant, token, syllable, timepoint, normF0)


#onset/offset data

onset.thai = f0.thai.8points%>%
  filter(timepoint == 2)%>%
  rename(onset = normF0)%>%
  select(language, tone, informant, token, syllable, onset)

offset.thai = f0.thai.8points%>%
  filter(timepoint == 9)%>%
  rename(offset = normF0)%>%
  select(language, tone, informant, token, syllable, offset)

#re-calculating data from 10-90%
meanf0.thai = f0.thai.8points%>%
  group_by(language, tone, informant, token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(f0mean =mean(normF0))

excursion.thai = f0.thai.8points%>%
  group_by(language, tone, informant, token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(excursion = max(normF0)-min(normF0))

maxloc.thai = f0.thai.8points%>%
  group_by(language, tone, informant, token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(maxloc = which.max(normF0)/8)


thai.discrete = onset.thai%>%
  left_join(offset.thai, by = c ("language", "tone", "informant", "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(meanf0.thai, by = c ("language", "tone", "informant", "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(excursion.thai, by = c ("language", "tone", "informant", "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(maxloc.thai, by = c ("language", "tone", "informant", "token", "syllable"))

# output thai data
write.csv(thai.discrete,  
          file = paste(dir.processed, 
                       paste("thai.discrete",
                             Sys.Date(),
                             "csv",
                             sep = "."),
                       sep = "") ,row.names = FALSE)



##### md and sv ###########




# mandarin and sv data

md.f0.8point <- read_csv(paste(dir.interim,
                               paste("f0.md.10pnt",
                               "2020-12-29",
                               "csv",
                               sep = "."),
                               sep = ""))%>%
              group_by(subject)%>%
              # select timepoint
              filter(timepoint>1 & timepoint < 10)%>%
              mutate(F0norm = (F0 - mean(F0))/sqrt(sum(F0^2)/length(F0)),
                      language = "md")%>%
            group_by(bundle, id)%>%
            mutate(timepoint = 1:n())%>% # recode timepoint
            select("language","subject","F0","isi","id","tone","speaker",
         "vowel_vari","syllable", "token",
         "timepoint","F0norm","bundle","cgload","informant")%>%
                select(language, informant = subject, isi, id, tone, 
                       speaker, vowel_vari, syllable, token, timepoint, 
                       normF0 = F0norm, session = bundle)

sv.f0.8point <-  read_csv(paste(dir.interim,
                                paste("f0.sv.10pnt",
                                        "2020-12-29",
                                          "csv",
                                        sep = "."),
                                        sep = ""))%>%
                         group_by(subject)%>%
                          # select timepoint
                       filter(timepoint>1 & timepoint < 10)%>%
             mutate(F0norm = (F0 - mean(F0))/sqrt(sum(F0^2)/length(F0)),
                    language = "sv")%>%
              group_by(bundle, id)%>%
              mutate(timepoint = 1:n())%>% # recode timepoint
            select("language","subject","F0","isi","id","tone","speaker",
         "vowel_vari","syllable", "token",
         "timepoint","F0norm","bundle","cgload","informant")%>%
          select(language, informant = subject, isi, id, tone, 
                  speaker, vowel_vari, syllable, token, timepoint, 
                  normF0 = F0norm, session = bundle)

#

# both mandarin and sv data
onset_all = md.sv.f0.8points%>%
  # this dataset has only 8 point
  filter(timepoint == 1)%>%
  rename(onset = normF0)%>%
  select(tone, language, session, id, isi, speaker, vowel_vari,informant, 
         token, syllable, onset)


offset_all = md.sv.f0.8points%>%
  filter(timepoint == 8)%>%
  rename(offset = normF0)%>%
  select(tone, language, session, id, isi, speaker, vowel_vari,informant, 
         token, syllable, offset)

#re-calculating data from 10-90%
meanf0_all = md.sv.f0.8points%>%
  group_by(tone, language, session,id,isi, speaker, vowel_vari,informant, 
           token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(f0mean = mean(normF0))

excursion_all = md.sv.f0.8points%>%
  group_by(tone, language, session,id,isi, speaker, vowel_vari,informant, 
           token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(excursion = max(normF0)-min(normF0))

maxloc_all = md.sv.f0.8points%>%
  group_by(tone, language, session,id,isi, speaker, vowel_vari,informant, 
           token, syllable)%>%
  summarise(maxloc = which.max(normF0)/8)

md.sv.discrete = onset_all%>%
  left_join(offset_all, by = c ("tone", "language", "session","id","isi", "speaker", "vowel_vari","informant", 
                               "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(meanf0_all, by = c ("tone", "language", "session","id","isi", "speaker", "vowel_vari","informant", 
                               "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(excursion_all, by = c ("tone", "language", "session","id","isi", "speaker", "vowel_vari","informant", 
                                  "token", "syllable"))%>%
  left_join(maxloc_all, by = c ("tone", "language", "session","id","isi", "speaker", "vowel_vari","informant", 
                               "token", "syllable"))


# output thai data
write.csv(md.sv.discrete,  
          file = paste(dir.processed, 
                       paste("md.sv.discrete",
                             Sys.Date(),
                             "csv",
                             sep = "."),
                       sep = "") ,row.names = FALSE)

```

library(tidymodels)
# calculate confidence intervals
library(rcompanion)

dir.interim = "data/interim/"
dir.processed = "data/processed/"

## 机器学习

# Thai data
# 2020-11-30 first remove 2 point and normalise
# 2020-12-29
thai.discrete = read.csv(paste(dir.processed, 
                       paste("thai.discrete",
                             "2020-11-30",
                             "csv",
                             sep = "."),
                       sep = ""))
### split the dataset ####
set.seed(123)
# thai.discrete
# 
# table(thai.test$tone)
# table(thai.train$tone)
# unique(thai.discrete$informant)
# length(unique(thai.discrete$informant))

thai.split = thai.discrete%>%
             mutate(tone = as.factor(tone))%>%
             # feature selection
             select(c(2,6,7,8,9,10))%>%
             initial_split(., prob = 0.70, 
                           # for each tone group
                              strata = tone)

thai.test = testing(thai.split)

thai.train = training(thai.split)

# thai.rcp = recipe(tone ~  .,
#                   data = thai.train)%>%
#            step_normalize(all_numeric()) 
# 
# # # preprocessed data
#    preprocessed <- thai.rcp %>%
#    # apply the recipe to the training data
#   prep(thai.train) %>%
# #   # extract the pre-processed training dataset
#   juice()
#  preprocessed

# fit the model
# Using the non-formula method with train will 
# pass the factor predictors to randomForest and everything will work.
# randomforest
rf_model = rand_forest(trees = 500, mode = "classification") %>%
  # specify that the `mtry` parameter needs to be tuned
  # set_args(mtry = tune()) %>%
  # select the engine/package that underlies the model
  # set_engine("randomForest", importance = "impurity") %>%
  set_engine("randomForest") %>%
  fit(tone ~ onset + offset + f0mean + excursion + maxloc, 
      data = training(thai.split))

#svm model
svm_model = svm_poly() %>% 
  set_engine("kernlab") %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  fit(tone ~ onset + offset + f0mean + excursion + maxloc, 
      data = training(thai.split))

#lda model
library(discrim)

lda_model = discrim_linear() %>% 
  set_engine("MASS") %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  fit(tone ~ onset + offset + f0mean + excursion + maxloc, 
      data = training(thai.split))
  

# build the workflow

# rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
#   # add the recipe
#   add_recipe(thai.rcp) %>%
#   # add the model
#   add_model(rf_model)

##### Tune the parameters (optional)#########

# create CV object from training data
thai_cv <- vfold_cv(thai.train)

# specify which values eant to try
rf_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = c(3, 4, 5))

# extract results
rf_tune_results <- rf_workflow %>%
  tune_grid(resamples = thai_cv, #CV object
            grid = rf_grid, # grid of values to try
            metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc) # metrics we care about
            )

# print results
rf_tune_results %>%
  collect_metrics()

# extract the best value for the accuracy metric 
param_final <- rf_tune_results %>%
  select_best(metric = "accuracy")
param_final

# add this parameter to the workflow
rf_workflow <- rf_workflow %>%
  finalize_workflow(param_final)

  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent*100, 1), color = text.color), 
            size = 4) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Model classifications as each Thai tone",
                   limits=c("21","33","45","315","241"))+
  scale_y_discrete(name = "Thai tones",
                   limits=c("21","33","45","315","241"))+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black", "white"))+
  ggtitle("") + 
  scale_fill_discrete(name="Percentage (%)")+
  scale_fill_gradient(name="%",
                      low = "white", high = "black") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold", size=10),
        #axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        #axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        #legend.position="none",
        panel.background = element_blank())+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  facet_wrap(~language, 
             nrow = 1,
             labeller=labeller(language = labels))+
  # remove the legend for color
  guides(color = FALSE)+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=10,face="bold", color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="white"))
